Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime

Class HttpReply

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime.HttpReply
public final class HttpReply extends Object
The HTTP answer of a function, the same on every target: the providers turn the result of a function, or the exception it threw, into status, headers and body with this class and only write it in the form of their platform.
  • a result: status 200 with the result as JSON; an HttpResponse with its status and headers
  • an HttpStatusException: its status and headers, body {"error": "<message>"}
  • a request body that cannot be read as the input type: 400, {"error": "Invalid request body"}
  • any other exception: 500, {"error": "Internal Server Error"}; the provider logs the exception (isUnexpected())

Used by the provider modules; functions use HttpResponse and HttpStatusException.
